title.narrative: Territorios circulares: Desarrollo de Cadenas de Valor territoriales y sostenibles

description.narrative: Contract related to: Territorios circulares: Desarrollo de Cadenas de Valor territoriales y sostenibles - The integration of sustainable practices in the economic system, industry and agro-livestock sectors is still incipient and Peru lacks a national strategy or formal green growth or Circular Economy plan. Still, Peru laid the foundations for embarking on a green growth agenda, strengthening its policy and regulatory frameworks, with:-         Guidelines for Green Growth (2016) (Ministry of Environment), -         Climate Change Framework Law (2018),-         National Competitiveness and Productivity Policy and Plan (2018),-         EU-supported Roadmaps towards a Circular Economy in the Industry Sector (2020), the Agriculture Sector (2021) and the Fisheries and Aquaculture Sector (2021), -         The Circular Peru Platform, a public-private-academia partnership, currently under development with EU assistance.Convinced that Team Europe can have a transformative impact driving the greening of Peru¿s economic system, EU partners in Peru have agreed and committed to the Team Europe Initiative (TEI) Circular Transition. The present Action is at the core of the TEI, supporting its steering and the bundling of EU policy and cooperation instruments, trade and investment. The EU is by far the main investor in Peru. Its private sector is dominant in economic areas in everything sustainable, environmental, social, and governance-related (ESG). The EU and MS have been providing substantial support to the circular economy. This includes the elaboration of Roadmaps towards a Circular Economy, the establishment of the Circular Peru Platform, the institutionalisation of the Mesa Verde, the donor coordination table on environmental matters and the organisation of so far four editions of the International Circular Economy Forum. Successful support to value chains has shown the potential for job and income generation in fair-trade/organic/sustainable agriculture, increasingly in demand by main markets like the EU and US. Building on current work, the Action shall further step up EU impact. The Action provides the means for deploying the TEI, with funding for specific actions and a solid support structure. It is conceived as a first stage that shall prepare the ground for a next phase enabling the mobilisation of EFSD+ guarantees and/or blending for leveraging investment. As the circular transition requires an integrated inter-sectoral approach, the Action will act at macro/legal, meso/institutional and service and micro/business level. It will engage the Peruvian private sector and civil society directly.
